verdict.rationale: Typed, structured extraction is documented only through third-party framework integrations: the AI SDK integration returns typed results, Pydantic AI and OpenAI Agents SDK support typed browser agents, and Pi can extract structured data. Steel's own Browser Tools only convert pages to markdown, readability output, screenshots or PDFs, so the schema validation comes from the external framework rather than Steel. Missing for 10: a native Steel extraction API that accepts a Zod/JSON/Pydantic schema, documentation of how schema validation behaves, and independent hands-on corroboration.
